description: AgentBox activity-state hooks (defense-in-depth seed; production state comes from the tmux-pane scraper in packages/ctl/src/codex-scraper.ts). Codex's strict parser allows only `description` and `hooks` at the top level. Loading needs `codex --enable hooks --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust` (both supplied by startCodexSession()). SessionStart and Stop also pass --capture-session: they buffer the hook's stdin JSON in the shell (at most 1 s) and hand it to a backgrounded agentbox-ctl, which appends its session_id to the box's session-history binding log (how a session on the shared codex volume is attributed to this box). Buffering first keeps the payload (a bare & would detach stdin) while codex never waits on ctl, whose client can spend 5 s restarting a dead daemon.

hooks.command: p=$(timeout 1 cat); printf '%s' "$p" | agentbox-ctl codex-state idle --capture-session >/dev/null 2>&1 &
p=$(timeout 1 cat); printf '%s' "$p" | agentbox-ctl codex-state idle --capture-session >/dev/null 2>&1 &
